note: One task instance, one artifact. The five shipped files are the pins-planning-002 worker artifact c861bd8f4acd9bbe... (gate 1.5.0 on the full artifact, failed_checks empty, exact-byte --accepted on the worker and re-accepted in job pins-planning-baseline-002); the package's code/ carries the construction script, the references implementation, the runner-workdir materializer and the gate, baseline/ the runner-contract baseline. The holdout ships as an asset like the other splits; it is not copied into any runner workdir and was never evaluated. The prediction instant is the appeal's Valid Date (event_time); the split key is that instant because the outcome date cannot ship (post-instant), the same construction as the published ipo-trademark-registration-outcome (filed_date) and ec-merger-phase2-opening (notification_date) tasks. Training-label timing is declared UNVERIFIED and the evaluation contract is retrospective research only. The LPA-history features embed other rows' labels through a declared cross-row probe (lpa_last_outcome over the previous same-LPA decided case), so honest evaluation requires isolated rows - stated as a requirement, never an enforcement claim; the shipped illustrative runner passes the whole eval feature table to the predictor. Recorded finding carried in measurements.json, RELEASE_NOTES.md and VERIFICATION.md: the stock runner baseline (eval AUC 0.6108) exceeds every measured simple reference on the identical 28,104 eval rows with paired row-level AND LPA-clustered intervals excluding zero (procedure-type rate 0.5551, LPA history rate 0.5414, shipped rate feature 0.5422; persistence 0.5045; the calendar-identity control collapsed onto the LPA rate exactly and is recorded as degenerate, not as independent confirmation) - demonstrated headroom over these references under this protocol, with its scope recorded beside it; no figure may be quoted without that comparison beside it.
